jobs.description:
Have you already gained some logistical experience and are you looking for a job that is easy to combine with your free time? Look no further, because at UPS, you are in the right place! You can also count on a gross salary of €15.85 per hour, travel allowance, pension accrual, and a chance for a permanent contract! Are you excited? Read on and apply today!

Employment agency Manpower is looking for multiple part-time order pickers for UPS in Amsterdam.

In this role, you will process incoming goods and packages. You will scan and check the packages and accompanying documents, sort the shipments, and load the trucks according to the route. You can imagine that accuracy is key. Furthermore, you will also do a lot of walking, lifting, and carrying, so it is important that you are physically fit.

There are different departments where you can work. During the application process, we will look at which department suits you best!

What's in it for you

    - Gross salary of €15.85 per hour including 1.38% ADV allowance
    
- Travel allowance according to UPS's scheme
    
- Part-time job that is easy to combine with other activities
    
- Free access to the e-learning platform Manpower Academy
    
- Pension plan via Manpower
    
- Temporary job with the chance of extension
    
- Friendly team with a great atmosphere
    
- Bonus of €250 per quarter

    - At least six months of work experience as an order picker, warehouse employee, logistics employee, or similar
    
- At least 18 years of age, because of the working activities and hours
    
- Good command of the Dutch or English language, due to safety regulations in the workplace
    
- Physically capable of performing heavier work such as lifting and carrying
    
- A Certificate of Conduct (VOG) plus a Security Clearance (VGB)
    
- Availability of at least 20 hours per week
    
- Flexibility regarding the working hours

Please note! You will need to have lived in the Netherlands for at least the past 8 years, because of the VGB Scree

Job description: Emirates Cabin Crew are responsible for delivering the Fly Better onboard experience to passengers across our global network. As a member of our Cabin Crew team, you will be the onboard representative of our brand, delivering our signature award-winning service while maintaining world-class safety standards. In the role, you will ensure the safety and comfort of our passengers, manage onboard service and maintain cabin cleanliness throughout each flight. You will respond to passenger requests, working collaboratively with your fellow colleagues to ensure a smooth flight. You will also uphold the highest of service standards in line with the Emirates Fly Better promise. Candidate profile: To be considered for Emirates Cabin Crew, you’ll need to be: Fluent in written and spoken English (additional languages are an advantage) A natural team player with a personality that shines At least 160cm tall and able to reach 212cm high Able to meet the UAE’s employment visa requirements At least 21 years old And have: At least 1 year of hospitality or customer service experience A minimum of high school (Grade 12) education No visible tattoos while in Emirates Cabin Crew uniform Salary information: Your salary includes a fixed basic pay and variable flying pay, which is calculated using number of hours you fly during the month. Salaries are paid monthly. What the company offers: Emirates offers career progression opportunities as you grow in knowledge, skills and confidence. From providing the best customer experience in Economy Class to leading the whole team as purser, we always strive to provide our staff with development pathways that matches your personal and professional ambitions. All Emirates Cabin Crew enjoy a wealth of personal benefits. Furnished accommodation is provided free of charge, with utilities being paid for by the company. When you’re on duty, you’ll enjoy free company transport between your accommodation and the airport/training college,

SamenvattingLooking for a dynamic role in logistics with a well-known supermarket in Almere? As an Orderpicker, you’ll work in a fast-paced environment, enjoy great benefits, and have opportunities to grow. Start your logistics career in Almere today. - Work in both warm and cold areas of the warehouse

The workplace in Almere is a modern warehouse where efficiency and teamwork are highly valued. You can expect a friendly vibe, with team members supporting each other and a buddy system in place to help new colleagues get started. In the canteen, you’ll find free fruit and a warm meal during afternoon shifts, plus a coffee and tea station to keep you energized. If you enjoy an active job and being part of a supportive team, this is the place for you.
 Wat wij vragen- Private accommodation 
- Able to speak and understand English
- Available for at least 32 hours per week, including Saturdays
- Willing to work in both cold and warm areas and switch departments as needed
- Punctual, reliable, and a good team player
- No previous experience needed, but similar roles like ware

Samenvatting Step into the fast-paced world of logistics as an Orderpicker in Zoetermeer area?. This role gives you hands-on experience, growth opportunities, and a supportive team environment. If you’re looking for a fresh start and want to develop real skills, this is your chance. The atmosphere is open, with a mix of experienced staff and newcomers, and there’s always music playing to keep the energy up. If you’re looking for a place where you can learn, grow, and be part of a close-knit team, this is it.
Wat wij vragen- Own housing in the Netherlands required. No accommodation provided.
- No previous experience required – full training will be provided
- Basic knowledge of Dutch, Englis
